test_title: PYST 4: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
'A % B' means 'A is the husband of B'.

'A @ B' means 'A is the mother of B'.

'A $ B' means 'A is the sister of B'.

'A & B' means 'A is the parent of B'.

If, 'J % R, S $ J, P % D & S', then how is P related to R?
solution:
Family chart :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa630767dbe874568756af54011103fc5e912d865c7f38e9ddef1d5aeff31fda.png] 

**Decoding the Symbols:**

 
 

 Symbol 
 % 
 @

 & 
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 Husband
 Mother
 Sister
 Parent
 
 

Given: J % R, S $ J, P % D & S

It Means P is the **husband of R's husband's mother** , P is the **Father** of J, Since R is wife of J So **P is Father-in-law of R.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d8bb1f58790f68a4063335a843115331ab6ad1bbfbd2838f26ab48de8b5ff62.png] 

So, P is the **'Father-in-law'** of R.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
